FROM OUR FAMILY TO YOUR TABLE

More than a recipe.
A way of life.

It began in 1916, with Lala Kesar Mal Ji and his wife in Sheikhupura. A humble kitchen, an honest meal and a love for Punjabi food.

When the family made Amritsar their home during Partition, the recipes came with them. Today, that same spirit lives in every pot, every prantha and every warm welcome.
